name: headings
title: Headings
docs: Headings: one value of the element `flm.heading` per heading kind, written with the kind's heading commands (`\section` to `\subparagraph` by default); each heading carries a level, a reference point and its `\label` fields.

entries.name: flm.heading.number.lower.default
entries.summary: a heading's number lowers to `flm.pres.span` of role `flm.heading.number` around the number

entries.name: flm.heading.lower.default
entries.summary: a heading lowers to `flm.pres.block-heading` carrying its kind's name and level, whether it is listed in a table of contents, and its anchor, or, for a run-in kind, to a `flm.pres.deco.runin` decoration holding a `flm.pres.runin-heading` with the same payload; a numbered heading's content begins with its number

entries.name: flm.heading.lower.latex-recomposed
entries.summary: a heading lowers to the LaTeX hook `\flmHeading[toc=…]` (with `alt={…}` where the heading has an alternative title), a newline, the LaTeX sectioning command its heading kind maps to, starred when not numbered, and a group holding the labels it read from its `\label` fields

entries.name: flm.heading.number.lower.latex-recomposed
entries.summary: a heading's number lowers to its content; the heading itself is written back as its sectioning command, so the number never reaches this backend

entries.name: HeadingsConfig
entries.summary: The heading kinds and the heading commands that write them: each kind's level, counter, counter style, the counter it is numbered within, number format, heading title template, table-of-contents and run-in settings and reference point; each command's heading kind and default options; and which kinds are numbered. Fixed when the registry is built: it cannot vary per document or per render.

entries.name: HeadingsLatexOptions
entries.summary: The LaTeX sectioning command each heading kind is written as in the recomposed LaTeX, keyed by the kind's name; a kind not listed is written as the command of its own name. Set per render request.

entries.name: flm.headings.style
entries.summary: headings: no stylesheet of their own

entries.name: headings.headings
entries.summary: The heading kinds, in the order they were given.

entries.name: headings.commands

entries.name: headings.numbering
entries.summary:
Which kinds are numbered: `HeadingNumbering::NothingNumbered` by
default.

entries.name: headings.latex_commands
entries.summary:
The LaTeX sectioning command, without the backslash, that each heading
kind is written as, keyed by the kind's name. A kind the map does not list
is written as the command of its own name. Empty by default.
